content:
Context: 12. Payment of Gratuity under NPS Rules

- Rule 22 (2).  
In the event of discharge of a Government servant covered under NPS from service on account of invalidation or disablement and who has availed benefits from his accumulated pension corpus, in addition to the benefits available under NPS, death gratuity will also be admissible to him.  
- OM, dated 28-10-2022.  
3. Rounding off.The amount of Gratuity should be rounded off to the next higher rupee.
